name: step3_trim_cs0_objective_causal_preflight_protocol_v1
question: Does the fixed layer-24 residual state immediately before a constructive safe redirect carry prompt-specific information that is necessary, sufficient for local steering, and restorable at the C0R step64 checkpoint?
evidence_boundary: This stage can reject the TRIM premise or authorize a separate blinded generated-behavior review. It cannot establish mediation or authorize training.

data.selection: Responses beginning with I can't and containing the first exact case-insensitive transition marker I can help.
data.pairs: 20 deterministic unique same-category pairs across five categories; both directions form 40 instances.
data.wrong_donors: The paired recipient and one deterministic cross-category donor.
data.prefix_rule: The exact target text before I can help is forced; suffix text and safe-alternative details are excluded from donor-state capture.

primary_objective_effect: Mean wrong-donor suffix NLL minus correct-donor suffix NLL, paired by the 20 undirected prompt pairs.
staged_gate: All objective gates in the immutable registry must pass before any free-generation packet or blind behavior review. Passing authorizes review only; failing closes TRIM-CS0.
forbidden: No layer, token, checkpoint, prefix, donor, threshold, or decoding sweep.
No optimizer step or model-weight modification.
No claim from NLL or internal activations alone.
